_note: Every gesture = hands held IN FRAME of a narrow head-mounted FPV camera. No body touch, no face, no head. Each entry documents the physical hand shape so a vision model can detect it. meanings = plausible vision readings of that same shape (never grammar variants).

wave_hand.shape: Open hand raised in frame, waving side to side. Same wave greets and farewells — context decides.

point_toward_self.shape: Index finger pointing back toward self/camera, hand held in frame. STRESS: also reads as 'I am' — same hand, grammar role unresolved.

point_at_person.shape: Index finger extended pointing at another person or group. Referent resolved by pointing direction + context. STRESS: also reads as 'you are' — same hand.

point_somewhere.shape: Index finger extended pointing at a direction or spot.

point_down_low.shape: MOVA CONVENTION: finger pointing steeply down in frame, in the direction of one's own belly region. Reads as stomach area.

open_palm_request.shape: Open palm facing up/forward toward partner, held steady (asking/receiving hand).

cup_hold_mime.shape: Hand in C-shape as if holding an invisible cup, held steady in frame. Vessel AND action AND liquid all read from one shape — 'drink' is the honest reading when liquid is unknown.

spoon_scoop_mime.shape: Hand scooping air in small repeated arcs as if eating with a spoon, staying in frame. Ongoing action reads as eating; wanting-food state reads as hungry.

food_bowl_hold.shape: Both hands cupped side by side as if holding a bowl toward camera. Dish inside is unknown.

where_sign.shape: FIXED: both palms up, hands shaking side to side (universal where-shrug), face never needed.

what_sign.shape: FIXED: single palm up flicked upward once.

who_sign.shape: FIXED: index finger extended, sweeping sideways across people.

why_sign.shape: MOVA CONVENTION: index finger traces a ? shape in the air, in frame.

when_sign.shape: FIXED: index finger draws a small clock-circle in the air, in frame.

how_sign.shape: FIXED: both open palms rolling around each other (universal how gesture).

which_sign.shape: FIXED: open hand tilting side to side between two options (weighing gesture), in frame.

toilet_fist_sign.shape: MOVA CONVENTION (common S-Asian colloquial sign): fist with thumb protruding between index and middle finger, shaken lightly in frame.

folded_hands.shape: Both palms pressed together, fingers up, held STATIC in frame (namaste hold).

begging_palms.shape: Palms together RUBBING repeatedly (pleading motion). Dynamic, distinguishable from static folded_hands by motion.

one_finger.shape: FIXED: single index finger held up facing camera. One shape, many readings — counting, ranking, pointing up.

two_fingers.shape: FIXED: index + middle fingers in V held up facing camera. Count and victory share one shape.

three_fingers.shape: FIXED: three fingers held up facing camera.

phone_hand_shape.shape: Shaka/call handshape (thumb + pinky out) held up IN FRAME, never taken to ear.

prescription_scribble.shape: Index finger scribbling fast on the open other palm, both hands in frame (writing-prescription mime).

fist_clench_shake.shape: Tightly clenched fist shaken in frame (pain/grams of hurt). Distinct from toilet fist by thumb position + shake size.

beckon_fingers.shape: Fingers curling repeatedly toward self (beckoning), hand in frame. Ongoing invitation also reads as coming.

push_palm.shape: Open palm pushing outward away from self, in frame. Setting-off motion also reads as going. (Walking needs its own fingers-walking gesture — deferred.)

roof_hands.shape: Fingertips of both hands meeting in an upside-V roof shape, in frame.

tap_wrist.shape: Index finger tapping the other wrist, both hands held in frame. Exact day is unknown — today/now/tomorrow share one tap.

thumbs_up.shape: Thumb extended upward facing camera. Affirmation in all its shades — one shape.

thumbs_down.shape: Thumb pointed down facing camera. The mirror of thumbs_up — disapproval in all shades.

finger_wag_no.shape: Index finger wagging side to side (universal no-no), hand in frame.

money_rub_fingers.shape: Thumb rubbing against index/middle fingertips repeatedly (universal money/bill sign), in frame.

offer_hands.shape: Both palms extended forward presenting toward partner (giving motion), in frame. Distinct from open_palm_request (single palm up toward self).

with_link.shape: FIXED: both index fingers hooked together (universal together/with sign), in frame.

repeat_sign.shape: REGISTERED EMBLEM: index finger drawing small circles in the air (universal again/repeat), in frame. 'Repeat that' vs 'come again' share the circles — context decides.

cross_forearms.shape: REGISTERED EMBLEM: both forearms crossed in a big X in frame (forbidden/unsafe/stop). Distinct from finger_wag_no by size and two-arm involvement.

joke_wave.shape: REGISTERED EMBLEM: open palm waving loosely side to side (just-kidding wave), in frame.

talk_flap.shape: Fingers + thumb opening-closing repeatedly (talking-mouth mime), hand in frame.

hold_palm_wait.shape: Open palm facing partner held STATIC (hold-on), no pushing motion. Distinct from push_palm by zero motion. Waiting and holding-on share one still palm.

ok_ring.shape: Thumb + index forming a circle facing camera (OK sign). Reads as ok / got-it / understand.
